figure_description: Five shapes labeled A through E in a row: A is a quarter-circle consisting of a vertical line segment and a horizontal line segment meeting at a right angle, joined by an arc; B is a circle; C is a rectangle whose four corners are rounded curves; D is a five-sided polygon with a horizontal bottom edge, two vertical side edges, and two sloped top edges that meet at a point; E is a starburst shape with pointed projections radiating around a circular center.
